# truenas_iscsi_global (Data Source)

Reads the current TrueNAS global iSCSI service configuration. Takes no arguments: there is exactly one iSCSI global configuration per TrueNAS system.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `alua` (Boolean) Whether Asymmetric Logical Unit Access (ALUA) is enabled.
- `basename` (String) Base name (iSCSI Qualified Name prefix) used when generating target names.
- `id` (String) Fixed identifier for this singleton: always "iscsi_global".
- `iser` (Boolean) Whether iSER (iSCSI Extensions for RDMA) is enabled.
- `isns_servers` (List of String) List of iSNS server hostnames or IP addresses.
- `listen_port` (Number) TCP port the iSCSI service listens on.
- `pool_avail_threshold` (Number) Percentage of pool free space remaining that triggers a warning alert. 0 means disabled.
